en: This postcard shows a panoramic view of a European city nestled in a mountainous landscape. The foreground features a well-maintained park with winding paths, stone staircases, and lush greenery. Prominent in the center are several historical buildings with steep red-tiled roofs and ornate architectural details. One building appears to be a church or monastery with large arched windows and another is a tower-like structure. The city extends into the background, surrounded by forested hills and distant mountains.
